title: The Lantern Garden
goal: Find the garden lantern and light the surprise.
intro: A dark lantern waits on the hill. Your friends have clues and a tool to help you light it.
recap: You found a tool, followed the clue, and lit the lantern together.
reveal: Surprise! Grown-up opens the lantern. A tiny glowing garden is growing inside.
hook: Tomorrow, a tiny path inside the lantern leads somewhere new.

rooms.name: Lantern trail
lines: Our friends need a light for their surprise. Shall we find the lantern together?
You found the light. Come back whenever you want.

rooms.name: Clue grove
lines: I found a clue beside this path. It will help us reach the surprise.
You followed my clue and opened the path.

rooms.name: Lantern workshop
lines: There is an extra discovery in my workshop. You can visit whenever you want.
Your extra discovery can stay in your backpack.

rooms.name: Surprise hill
lines: Grown-up has a surprise waiting. Help me light the lantern.
Look at the tiny garden glowing inside the lantern.
